profile.headline: Studied at Virginia State University
profile.summary: A motivated Computer Engineer driven to augment his professional experience and educational background in career opportunities relative to the software and hardware field.

positions.title: Expert Data Analyst
positions.description:
Worked in the IT and Central Business Office under Transaction Posting.  
Used EPIC Database to move and regulate files dealing with Insurance Payors throughout the system.
Overviewed and managed various Insurance Billing Remittances such as Aetna, Blue Cross, Cigna etc. 
Processed a large volume of payments and company remits to upload on a real-time database. 
Worked in a productive teamwork environment to maximize project lifecycle and company revenue.
Systems and Supporting Network Engineer.

positions.title: Research Analyst/Peer Mentor
positions.description:
	Researched and designed methods on making multi-solar panels on Solar Bike’s more efficient.
	Mentored students in advanced courses such as Java, C#, Differential Equations, and Circuit Analysis.
	Programmed micro-controllers such as Arduino and/or Raspberry Pi for assigned projects.
	Implemented various software and hardware applications such as VHDL and Xilinx.
	Ordered and documented inventory of different lab equipment, while keeping stock in order.

positions.title: Information Technology Intern
positions.description:
	Information Technology Team member of the new Enterprise Architecture division in the Summer.
	Developed and overviewed diverse databases information running under Oracle and .Net.
	Answered phone calls and assisted the public with needs or resolving a problem.
	Acquired knowledge on Business Resource Management and KANBAN procedure.
	Experience with SharePoint and Agile framework.

positions.title: Help Desk Specialist
positions.description:
	Executed Data Entry of clients and students in Microsoft Excel and use of Microsoft Office.
	Performed on campus Customer Service with clients and/or students with server and network issues.
	Serviced damaged laptops and other equipment at the community college.
	Extensive knowledge in general programming and basic coding structures/computer architecture.
